cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.Avatar: Croatian has adopted 'avatar' unchanged for a profile picture; core hr uses it too, so translating it would invent a term users do not know.
cognates.CSV: File-format initialism, identical in Croatian; every other finished locale keeps it as-is.
cognates.Deck: Proper name of the Nextcloud Deck app; product names are not translated.
cognates.DSAR: Initialism for Data Subject Access Request. Croatian GDPR practice has coined no equivalent acronym, and the expanded key 'Data-subject access request' is translated in full alongside it.
cognates.Excel (.xlsx): Product name plus a file extension; both are invariant in Croatian.
cognates.Format: Croatian uses 'format' unchanged for a data/display format; core hr has no competing term.
cognates.ID: Initialism written identically in Croatian; the lowercase variant key 'Id' is normalised TO this form rather than left alone.
cognates.ID:: Same initialism with a colon. Croatian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.ID: {id}: Same initialism plus the placeholder; nothing in this string differs in Croatian.
cognates.Interval: Croatian 'interval' is the standard term and is spelled identically.
cognates.Minimum: Croatian 'minimum' is the standard term and is spelled identically; the derived 'Minimum length/value' keys are translated as 'Minimalna …'.
cognates.OpenDocument (.ods): Product name plus a file extension; both are invariant in Croatian.
cognates.PDF: File-format initialism, identical in Croatian; every other finished locale keeps it as-is.
cognates.RBAC: Initialism for role-based access control, used untranslated in Croatian IT writing; the expanded prose keys around it are translated in full.
cognates.Slug: Croatian technical writing keeps the English 'slug' for a URL-friendly identifier; no Croatian equivalent is in use, and the descriptive key 'Optional URL-friendly identifier' is translated in full beside it.
cognates.Status: Croatian 'status' is the standard term and is spelled identically; core hr confirms it.
cognates.URL: Initialism written identically in Croatian; the lowercase-variant key 'Url' is normalised TO this form, and 'Database URL' etc. are translated as 'URL baze podataka'.
cognates.UUID:: Initialism with a colon. Croatian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.Webhook: Croatian keeps 'webhook' and declines it ('webhookovi', 'webhookove'); the nominative singular is therefore identical to the English key.
cognates.N/A: Abbreviation shown as-is; not translated in this UI.
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR product term; SOLR does not localise it and the admin UI names the same object.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR product term with its label colon; see ConfigSet.
cognates.HNSW index: Algorithm name (hierarchical navigable small world); an invariant technical term.
cognates.OpenCorporates: Proper noun — a third-party service name.
cognates.OpenRegister: Proper noun — this application's own name.
cognates.http://localhost:11434: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.https://api.your-dolphin-instance.com: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.https://example.com/webhook: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
A literal API-key prefix example shown verbatim; not prose.

A literal organisation-id prefix example shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.X-Custom-Header: value\nAuthorization: B: Literal HTTP header example; header names are protocol tokens and are never translated.
cognates.X-Custom-Header: value\\nAuthorization:: Literal HTTP header example with an escaped newline; header names are protocol tokens.
cognates.objectType: object\\naction: created: Literal CloudEvents payload example; the field names are protocol tokens.
cognates.objectType: object\naction: created: Literal CloudEvents payload example; the field names are protocol tokens and are never translated.
cognates.Driver: Database-driver term, used unchanged in this locale's technical language.
cognates.Host *: Networking term, used unchanged in this locale, with the required-field marker.
cognates.Id: Abbreviation of identifier, written the same way in this locale's technical UI.
cognates.Model: Same spelling and meaning in this locale.
cognates.myapp: A literal example application id shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.Ollama URL: Product name plus the invariant abbreviation URL.
cognates.Test: Same spelling and meaning in this locale.
cognates.Url: Invariant abbreviation, written the same way in this locale.
cognates.{property} - {other}: Two placeholders joined by a dash; there is no prose to translate.
cognates.Browser Web Push (VAPID): Browser and Web Push are the protocol's own names and VAPID is its acronym; the protocol name is not translated.
cognates.Bucket: Object-storage term, used unchanged in this locale's technical language.
cognates.Golden record: Master-data-management term with no established local equivalent; used unchanged in data-governance language.
cognates.Survivor: Master-data-management term for the record that survives a merge; used unchanged in data-governance language.

corrections.Categories of data subjects (one per lin: batch 1 wrote the paraphrase "osoba čiji se podaci obrađuju"; "ispitanik" is the term used by the official Croatian text of the GDPR
corrections.create: written as the imperative "stvori" before PermissionMatrix.vue showed this renders as a COLUMN HEADER in actions:[read,create,update,delete,manage], so it is a permission name — verbal noun "stvaranje"
corrections._%n entry has no hash yet_::_%n entries: Trimmed from three plural forms to two. hr declares nplurals=2 in its own catalogue header, and a form array longer than the locale's nplurals renders BLANK for the counts that select the missing index.
